compose_video_transforms: build a python module that uses Compose to chain multiple video transforms on a clip of frames
random_drop_frames: create a function that uses RandomDrop to randomly select a fixed number of frames from a video clip
uniform_drop_frames: create a function that uses UniformDrop to uniformly subsample frames from a video clip by count or ratio
random_resized_crop_clip: build a python module that uses RandomResizedCrop to crop and resize video frames with random scale and aspect ratio
temporal_jitter_clip: create a function that uses TemporalJitter to temporally subsample a video clip with configurable time scale
